validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: strongly confirmed -- independently by RIA Novosti (federal wire) and KVnews.ru (regional press) both reporting the Dec 18-20, 2025 gas launch, with the operator's Sept-2026 quality passport confirming continued operation. This is the most completely evidenced of the three rows in this family group: Length (94.00 km) and Start (2025) both match the recorded sheet values exactly against two independent sources. DUPLICATE: no other roster PID duplicates this Bolsherechenskaya-Tarskaya corridor; it shares its Bolsherechenskaya GRS endpoint with P3980 (Andreevskaya-Ingaly-Bolsherechenskaya), which is expected (a shared GRS is a legitimate junction node between two distinct отводы, not double-counting -- P3980 feeds INTO GRS Bolsherechenskaya, this row continues OUT of it toward Tara). ATTRIBUTION: Gazprom PJSC ownership well-supported. CLASSIFICATION concern as stated above. SPEC: Diameter (325 mm) could not be independently confirmed despite reading both launch-coverage sources in full; left UNRESOLVED.
